to.name: GNU C Library Name Service Switch

property: configurable per-database dispatch from libc lookup APIs to multiple name-service backends, including terminology/name

sources.supports: glibc says NSS was designed after the Solaris 2 method and follows its name.

negative_claims: glibc explicitly says there is no common source code with Sun's implementation.
glibc documents the internal interface as incompatible with Sun's implementation.
open_questions: Pin earliest glibc NSS release and contemporary Solaris documentation for syntax/API comparison.
notes: Canonical example of design influence without source-code ancestry.
